adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it unconditionally enqueues `:retrieve_topic` on every request (`Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)`) with no controller-level dedup. In `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`, staff users set `no_throttle: user.try(:staff?)`, and `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` explicitly disables throttling when `@opts[:no_throttle]` is true, so rapid staff-driven page loads will cause repeated outbound fetch attempts until the embed exists. Even for non-staff, duplicates can still be enqueued (the Redis guard only affects execution, not enqueue). Additionally, `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` only guards with a non-atomic `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: ...).exists?` check; concurrent jobs can both pass it and then race in `TopicEmbed.import`, where the second `TopicEmbed.create!` will hit the unique index on `embed_url` and raise, making the job fail. This is a diff-grounded correctness/robustness issue under concurrency/load.
